name: Delete Users CSV
description: Admin form that deletes user accounts matched by email address from an uploaded CSV file, via a batch. Gated by core 'administer users'; destructive.
project_description: This module lets an administrator delete multiple user accounts through the admin interface. Upload a CSV file that contains the email addresses of the accounts to remove and click “Upload CSV and delete users”; any value containing '@' in any row or column is treated as an email and the matching accounts are deleted in a batch. Enable the module, then visit /admin/delete-users-csv.
